prior_record_addendum: PROVENANCE-005 previously marked internal naming rationale UNKNOWN for all four Google element models. PROVENANCE-007 supersedes that blanket statement for Argon only: first-party spokesperson attributed its name to internal Google team practice. Exact proposer and selection rationale remain unknown; Carbon/Hydrogen/Neon remain unresolved at that granularity.
limitations: Third-party caption transcript may contain transcription errors; direct video corroborates speaker/topic but specific wording should be treated as speech attributed by captions until independently transcribed.
Google spokespeople's statements do not independently document the internal naming decision date.
Google's public articles establish product announcements, not personal authorship of names.
No ROOT0 material access by Google personnel demonstrated.
